name: Let It Blow!
source:
Stuck in your car on a snowy road in the middle of nowhere, you can only dream of a Christmas with your parents and sisters. Luckily, there's someone to rescue you along the way.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你连人带车被困在荒郊野外一条积雪的路上，和父母、姐妹一起过圣诞成了奢望。好在途中有人来救你。

［取自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]］
